pages.en:
SPECIAL BRANCH REGISTRY.
File No. J-0-387

SUBJECT

Inquiry by request of Mixed Court Magistrate
re a Chinese Military Officer absconded from
Kiangyin to S'hai.
pages.zh:
特别处档案室。
档案编号 J-0-387

事由

应会审公廨推事之请求，就一名从江阴潜逃至上海的中国军官一事进行调查。

pages.en:
Form 2
Shanghai Municipal Police.
887
10/6/16
Central Police Station.
June 8th, 1916.

REPORT ON Letter from Magistrate Kwan re Military Officer named
Siau Kwong Lee who Absconded.

Made by D. S. Givens. Forwarded by

Sir,
I beg to report that No. 1,111 Mo Teh Lee alleyway, Mohawk
Road, is occupied by a tallyman named Wo Ching Ming (胡金銘)
whose family has resided there for the past ten years. There
is nobody in the house bearing the name of Siau Kwong Lee, and
none of the inmates has features like those of the person in
the photograph.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D. S. Givens
Detective Sergeant.

Chief Detective Inspector.

This has been sent
been forwarded to him
since ?
?

H.O.
? Sev. 9/6/16
No. S. I. Wheeler states he
sent it to Luiza on 16th alt,
Your obt. servant,
D. S. Givens D.S.
pages.zh:
表格 2
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
887
1916年6月10日
中央捕房。
1916年6月8日。

关于关推事来信提及潜逃军官萧光礼（Siau Kwong Lee）的报告。

由 D. S. Givens 撰写。转呈

先生，
谨此报告，莫霍克路（Mohawk Road）马立师里（Mo Teh Lee alleyway）1111号由一名名为胡金銘（Wo Ching Ming）的理货员居住，其家人在过去十年间一直居于此地。屋内并无名为萧光礼（Siau Kwong Lee）之人，且住户中无一人的相貌与照片中的人相似。

此致，
敬礼
D. S. Givens
警佐侦探。

首席巡官侦探长。

此件已发送
已转交给他
自？
？

总部。
？ 1916年6月9日
S. I. Wheeler 先生称他
已于上月16日将其发送至 Luiza（音译），
您忠实的仆人，
D. S. Givens 警佐侦探。

pages.en:
Form 81
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CAPTAIN SUPERINTENDENT'S OFFICE.
Translation of a letter from the Mixed Court Magistrate to Capt.Supt.of Police.
June 3, 1916.
I have to state that I received a telegram from
the Chiangchun of Nanking through the Commissioner
of Foreign Affairs of Kiangsu, stating as follows :-
" When the soldiers mutinied at Kiangyin on
this occasion ex-Military Councillor Siau Kwong Lee
(蕭光禮) of the 75th Regiment started a rebellion,
fired cannons towards the City, ruined the district
and spoiled the Military law.
It is now ascertained that this culprit has
absconded to Shanghai where he is staying in
No. 1111 馬德里 Mo Teh Lee alleyway. 馬立師 Morriss Village.
Orders are hereby issued to capture him
according to the address and send him inland
after examination. "
✓ On receipt of the above a warrant for arrest has been issued.
This is on record.
The Commissioner of Foreign Affairs is now forwarding to me
a copy of Siau Kwong Lee's photo which I send you(C.S.P.)
herewith and hope you will accept it and hand over to the
detectives.and instruct them to arrest and bring him to
this Court for preliminary hearing, thus obliging.
With greetings of the day.
Card of Kuan Chun.
Siau Kwong Lee's photo attached.
Cm
In office
6/3
pages.zh:
表格 81
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警务处处长办公室。
会审公廨推事致警务处处长的信函译文。
1916年6月3日。
兹声明，本人经由江苏交涉员收到南京蒋将军（Chiangchun）发来的电报，内容如下：
“此次江阴士兵哗变之际，第七十五团前军事参议萧光礼（Siau Kwong Lee）发动叛乱，向城内开炮，破坏该地区并扰乱军纪。
现已查明，该罪犯已潜逃至上海，现居于马立师里（Morriss Village）马立师里（Mo Teh Lee alleyway）1111号。
特此命令按上述地址将其逮捕，经审讯后押送内地。”
✓ 收到上述电报后，已签发逮捕令。
此在案记录。
交涉员现正将萧光礼的照片副本转交予我，兹随函送交阁下（警务处处长），望请查收并转交侦探人员，指示他们将其逮捕并带至本庭进行初步审讯，不胜感激。
顺颂时祺。
关春（Kuan Chun）名片。
附萧光礼照片。
Cm
在办公室
6/3

pages.en:
June 6,                                                                 6.

Kuan Chun, Esq.,
    Mixed Court Magistrate,
        Shanghai.

Dear Sir,
    I have to acknowledge receipt of
your letter dated June 3 regarding the man
Siau Kwong Lee (        ), and to inform you
that the matter will receive immediate attention.

    With compliments,

        I am,

    Yours faithfully,

Captain-Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
6月6日，                                                                 6.

关春 先生，
    会审公廨推事，
        上海。

尊敬的先生，
    谨此确认收到您6月3日关于萧光礼（        ）一事的来信，并告知您此事将立即予以关注。

    此致，
    敬礼

    您忠实的，

警务处处长。
